subject: Re: Field Engage Summit — co-hosted demo & content swap with Quarry Labs
messages:
From: Asha Ramanathan <asha@quarrylabs.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Quarry Labs Marketing <marketing@quarrylabs.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Field Engage Summit — quick partner ask

Hi Logan —

Hope you’re well. Quarry is planning our presence at Field Engage (SF) Nov 16–17 and we’d love to run a short joint session with Redwood — a 25-min customer-facing demo followed by a 10-min cross-posted post on both blogs.

High level ask: co-run a live demo showing a provider switch (Quarry pipeline -> Redwood inference) and surface some latency/cost slides. We can also split a small booth corner for a 2-day shared demo rotation.

Do you have capacity to co-sponsor a shared booth and nominate a speaker? We can cover half of the booth cost and amplify across our social + invite lists.

If this sounds feasible I’ll pull a short draft agenda and marketing requirements.

Thanks —
Asha Ramanathan
Head of Partnerships, Quarry Labs
asha@quarrylabs.ai

Attachments: none
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Asha Ramanathan <asha@quarrylabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field Engage Summit — quick partner ask

Hi Asha —

This is something we can definitely support. Thanks for the invite — Field Engage aligns well with the infra + platform folks we’re targeting.

Quick thoughts / asks from our side:
- We can commit a 25-min session: 15-min joint demo, 10-min Q&A. Logan (me) will do the Redwood demo; would you nominate a Quarry engineer to demo the ingestion/workflow side?
- Shared booth: happy to split costs. Would like a basic layout for lead capture and a small table for hands-on demos (I sketched a quick booth layout).
- Marketing swap: blog co-post + two social posts each. We should lock the blog drafts by Nov 2 to make the event PR window (Nov 4 announcement).

I’ve attached a very rough agenda and a booth sketch (for internal ops). Can Marissa and Ben help confirm speaker availability and promotions cadence?

Action items:
1) Asha: confirm Quarry speaker name + bio by Oct 28
2) Marissa: confirm content calendar / copy deadlines
3) Ben: confirm booth logistics budget and lead capture approach

Thanks — looking forward to this.

—Logan
Logan Wright | Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Quarry_FieldEngage_Agenda_v1.pdf, booth-sketch-A3.png
From: Asha Ramanathan <asha@quarrylabs.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Quarry Labs Marketing <marketing@quarrylabs.ai>, press@quarrylabs.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field Engage Summit — quick partner ask

Hi Logan + team —

Great — thanks for the quick reply. We’ll nominate Siddharth Rao (Sr. Platform Eng) to co-demo the ingestion pipeline and do the live switching flow. Bio attached.

A few notes from our marketing side:
- We’ll need the final slide deck and short demo script by Nov 4 to produce the promo clip.
- Can Redwood provide a single one-page data point sheet (latency/cost delta) for our PR team?
- For lead capture: Quarry will run a QR-to-form (we use HubSpot). If Redwood has a preferred webhook or shared CSV export format, please share.

We also propose a small pre-event webinar (30 min) on Nov 9 as an intro teaser to drive booth traffic — open to Redwood hosting or co-hosting.

Thanks —
Asha

Attachments: siddharth-rao-bio.pdf
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Field Engage Summit — quick partner ask

Looping in a couple quick ops / product questions so we’re aligned before we commit to the pre-event webinar and the shared demo flow.

Priyom here — two asks:
1) Lead capture flow: is the plan to merge Quarry HubSpot leads into our inbound pipeline? If so we need a CSV template and a PII checklist (consent + retention period). I attached a generic template we use that Quarry can map to.
2) Demo script constraints: do we want to show a full provider switch with live keys/data? If not, we should plan a short recorded segment for the sensitive parts and live the rest. Also confirming whether we’ll run the demo on Redwood Dedicated or Hosted — affects the latency numbers.

I’ve attached our lead-capture CSV and a short runbook for demo fallbacks. Ben — can you confirm if the Dedicated pool is available for Nov 9 teaser and Nov 16 demo?

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Field Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: lead-capture-template.csv, demo-fallback-runbook.md
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Asha Ramanathan <asha@quarrylabs.ai>, Quarry Labs Marketing <marketing@quarrylabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Field Engage Summit — quick partner ask

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations so we can lock things this week.

Confirmed:
- Speaker: Siddharth Rao (Quarry) + Logan Wright (Redwood) for the Nov 16 slot.
- Pre-event teaser: Nov 9, 30-min hosted as webinar (Redwood will host; Quarry will provide 2 slides + short clip).
- Infra: Ben confirmed Dedicated pool reserved for Nov 9 and Nov 16 demos (will send capacity note).
- Marketing: Marissa will coordinate blog copy and social cadence; deadline Nov 2 for blog draft (Marissa: asking for 24-hr turnaround here).
- Lead capture: we’ll accept Quarry HubSpot exports. Priyom’s template above is fine — Quarry to confirm mapping by Nov 4.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Asha: map lead fields to template & send to priom_das by Nov 4
- Marissa: blog draft and event copy to Asha by EOD Nov 2
- Ben: send brief on Dedicated pool capacity (incl. token limits) by Nov 3
- Priyom: finalize demo fallback runbook and a one-pager on what must be recorded vs live by Nov 4

I’ll create the shared calendar event and a Drive folder named Redwood-Quarry-FieldEngage. Please add any final items.

—Logan
